title: The prompt asks for a thorough audit and fix, but the golden workbook corrects only the sign-convention errors and leaves other genuine errors in place, so an agent that fixes them fails the exact-match check.

title: Broken ratio references are kept in the golden, and correcting them moves values by far more than the 1% tolerance inside the graded range.
evidence: Golden 'Line Item Metrics'!H24 = H14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:J27) skips I and averages 3 years; fixing it to H27:I27 changes the denominator from about 2004 to 1681. H35 = 'Balance Sheet'!J22/H12 (=0.570); the correct I22/H12 is about 0.577 (+1.2%). Row 35 is offset by one column through L35, and M35 = O22 gives 0. All of these sit in graded range A2:I35.
confirmation: Golden 'Line Item Metrics'!H24 averages BS H27:J27 (pattern is H27:I27; denominator 2004 vs 1681) and H35 = BS J22/H12 = 0.570 vs I22/H12 = 0.577; both sit in graded A2:I35 and H24 moves ~19%, beyond the 1% tolerance.
